name: John Smith
source:
A peaceful old man.
His bearing and words were very soft, his body was somewhat distinctive, it manifested ten years ago as a unique mix of Gnoll and Naga features. 
John Smith, in Seikyouan that meant "No one at all".
As Dorothy's adoptive father he was wary of visitors, he had every right to be, City Law wouldn't permit Arboritis hosts to live. 
The deeper it went, the more viciously Enforcers tried to take their lives.
(Edited from in-game text)
